cando.en.a0.u01.greet: Anaweza kusema hujambo, asante, tafadhali, samahani, na kwaheri katika hali za kila siku.

cando.en.a0.u01.basics: Anaweza kutumia misemo michache ya dharura: salamu, shukrani, na kuwaomba watu wapunguze mwendo.

cando.en.a1.u02.origin: Anaweza kusema anatoka nchi gani na kuwauliza wengine vivyo hivyo.
cando.en.a1.u03.family: Anaweza kutaja wanafamilia wa karibu na kusema mambo rahisi kuwahusu.
cando.en.a1.u04.count: Anaweza kuhesabu, kusema bei na umri, na kutambua namba anapozisikia.
cando.en.a1.u05.clock: Anaweza kuuliza na kutoa saa kwa maneno rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u05.dates: Anaweza kusema siku, tarehe, na tukio linapotokea.
cando.en.a1.u06.likes: Anaweza kusema chakula na kinywaji anachopenda na kutaka.
cando.en.a1.u07.order: Anaweza kuagiza chakula na kinywaji kwa heshima na kuomba bili.
cando.en.a1.u08.around-town: Anaweza kusema kilichopo mjini kwake na mahali vitu vilipo.
cando.en.a1.u09.routine: Anaweza kuelezea ratiba yake ya kila siku na mara ngapi anafanya mambo.
cando.en.a1.u10.jobs: Anaweza kusema anafanya kazi gani na kuwauliza wengine kuhusu kazi zao.
cando.en.a1.u11.possessions: Anaweza kusema anachomiliki na kuuliza wengine wanachomiliki.
cando.en.a1.u12.describe-things: Anaweza kutaja rangi na nguo na kuelezea vitu vinaonekanaje.
cando.en.a1.u13.ability: Anaweza kusema anachoweza na asichoweza kufanya na kutoa maombi rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u14.now: Anaweza kuelezea kinachoendelea karibu naye kwa wakati huu.
cando.en.a1.u15.weather: Anaweza kuzungumzia hali ya hewa na misimu kwa maneno rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u16.transport: Anaweza kununua tiketi, kufuata maelekezo rahisi, na kutumia usafiri wa umma.
cando.en.a1.u17.prices: Anaweza kuuliza bei ya vitu na kufanya manunuzi rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u18.describe-people: Anaweza kuelezea watu wanaonekanaje na tabia zao.
cando.en.a1.u19.hobbies: Anaweza kuzungumzia burudani na shughuli za wakati wa ziada anazofurahia.
cando.en.a1.u20.past: Anaweza kusema alikuwa wapi na alifanya nini katika sentensi rahisi za wakati uliopita.
cando.en.a1.u21.tell-past: Anaweza kusimulia hadithi fupi kuhusu wiki iliyopita akitumia vitenzi vya kawaida vya wakati uliopita.
cando.en.a1.u22.plans: Anaweza kuzungumzia mipango na kuwaalika watu kufanya mambo pamoja.
cando.en.a1.u23.feelings: Anaweza kusema anajisikiaje na kuelezea matatizo rahisi ya kiafya.
cando.en.a1.u24.home: Anaweza kuelezea nyumba yake na vyumba na vitu vilivyomo.
cando.en.a1.u25.compare: Anaweza kulinganisha watu, mahali, na vitu katika sentensi rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u26.connect: Anaweza kuunganisha mawazo rahisi kwa kutumia and, but, na because.
cando.en.a1.u27.about-me: Anaweza kujitambulisha kwa kifupi kwa mdomo: yeye ni nani, anafanya nini, na anapenda nini.
cando.en.a1.u28.show: Anaweza kuunganisha mada zote za arc katika kipindi kimoja cha marudio.
cando.en.a2.u01.interrupted: Anaweza kusema kilichokuwa kikiendelea wakati jambo jingine lilipotokea ghafla.
cando.en.a2.u01.ongoing: Anaweza kuelezea alichokuwa akifanya wakati fulani maalum uliopita.
cando.en.a2.u02.habits: Anaweza kuelezea tabia na hali za zamani ambazo si za kweli tena.
cando.en.a2.u02.then-now: Anaweza kulinganisha jinsi mambo yalivyokuwa zamani na jinsi yalivyo sasa.
cando.en.a2.u03.experiences: Anaweza kuuliza na kuzungumzia uzoefu wa maisha bila kusema lini, na kutofautisha been na gone.
cando.en.a2.u04.duration: Anaweza kusema muda gani jambo limekuwa la kweli, akitumia for na since.
cando.en.a2.u04.progress: Anaweza kusema alichokwisha kifanya, kinachomsalia kufanya, au alichomaliza hivi punde.
cando.en.a2.u05.past-vs-perfect: Anaweza kuchagua kati ya wakati uliopita rahisi na wakati uliopo timilifu kutegemea kama wakati umekamilika, na kusimulia mabadiliko na jinsi yalivyoanza.
cando.en.a2.u06.offers: Anaweza kutoa msaada au ahadi ya haraka akitumia will papo hapo.
cando.en.a2.u06.predictions: Anaweza kutoa utabiri rahisi kwa will, ikiwa ni pamoja na utabiri mfupi wa hali ya hewa.
cando.en.a2.u07.arrangements: Anaweza kueleza miadi iliyopangwa na wakati maalum, akitumia wakati uliopo endelevu.
cando.en.a2.u07.plans: Anaweza kuzungumzia mpango uliokwisha amuliwa, akichagua going to badala ya will.
cando.en.a2.u08.conditions: Anaweza kusema kinachotokea au kitakachotokea kama sharti fulani likitimizwa, akitumia if pamoja na wakati uliopo au will.
cando.en.a2.u08.timing: Anaweza kuunganisha tendo moja la baadaye na jingine akitumia when au as soon as.
cando.en.a2.u09.advice: Anaweza kutoa ushauri rahisi kuhusu matatizo ya kila siku, akitumia should na shouldn't.
cando.en.a2.u10.rules: Anaweza kueleza kanuni za mahali fulani na kusema kinachohitajika, kinachoruhusiwa, au kinachokatazwa, akitumia have to, must, na mustn't.
cando.en.a2.u11.requests: Anaweza kufanya ombi la heshima kwa could, na kutoa au kuomba anachotaka kwa would.
cando.en.a2.u12.possibility: Anaweza kusema kinachoweza kutokea au kuwa kweli, bila kudai kuwa ni hakika.
cando.en.a2.u13.quantity-questions: Anaweza kuuliza bei ya kitu au idadi iliyopo, akitumia how much na how many kwa usahihi.
cando.en.a2.u13.quantity-words: Anaweza kutumia many, much, na a lot of kwa usahihi na nomino zinazohesabika na zisizohesabika, na kuomba idadi rahisi anaponunua.
cando.en.a2.u14.amounts: Anaweza kusema jambo linapokuwa kubwa mno, halitoshi kabisa, au ni sawasawa, na kuomba kiasi kidogo akitumia a few au a little.
cando.en.a2.u15.equal: Anaweza kusema kama vitu viwili ni sawa au la, akitumia as … as na not as … as.
cando.en.a2.u15.manner: Anaweza kulinganisha jinsi jambo linavyofanywa vizuri, haraka, au mara ngapi, akitumia vielezi vya kulinganisha.
cando.en.a2.u16.feedback: Anaweza kuelezea jinsi jambo lilivyofanywa na jinsi lilivyofanywa vizuri au vibaya, akitumia vielezi vya jinsi na vya kiwango.
cando.en.a2.u17.gerunds: Anaweza kuzungumzia anachopenda na asichopenda kuhusu shughuli za wakati wa ziada, akitumia enjoy, like, love, hate, na stop kabla ya kitenzi cha -ing.
cando.en.a2.u18.goals: Anaweza kusema anachotaka, anachohitaji, anachotumaini, au alichoamua kufanya, akitumia kitenzi + to-infinitive.
cando.en.a2.u18.purpose: Anaweza kusema kwa nini alifanya au anafanya jambo, akitumia to + kitenzi kuonyesha kusudi.
cando.en.a2.u19.devices: Anaweza kueleza jinsi ya kutumia kifaa cha kila siku, akitumia phrasal verbs kama turn on/off na get up, na jozi za kitenzi + kiunganishi kama listen to, wait for, na look for.
cando.en.a2.u20.identify: Anaweza kuelezea kwa usahihi mtu, mahali, au kitu kwa kuongeza maelezo yanayokibainisha kwa who, which, au that.
cando.en.a2.u21.possession: Anaweza kusema kinachomilikiwa naye na na wengine bila kurudia nomino, akitumia mine, yours, his, hers, ours, na theirs.
cando.en.a2.u21.reflexive: Anaweza kusema wakati mtu yule yule anafanya na kupokea tendo, akitumia myself, yourself, na viwakilishi vingine vya -self/-selves.
cando.en.a2.u22.opinions: Anaweza kutoa maoni pamoja na sababu, kuongeza matokeo, na kufanya ulinganisho wa tofauti, akitumia because, so, na although.
cando.en.a2.u23.navigation: Anaweza kutoa na kufuata maelekezo mjini, akitumia into, through, across, along, past, na over kuonyesha mwendo.
cando.en.a2.u24.events: Anaweza kuuliza na kujibu maswali ya kina kuhusu tukio la hivi karibuni — nani alifanya nini, kilichotokea, na kwa nini — akichagua mpangilio sahihi wa maneno kwa maswali ya kiima na ya shamirisho.
cando.en.a2.u25.celebrations: Anaweza kuelezea sherehe ya utamaduni wake, kuilinganisha na nyingine, na kusema anachopenda kuihusu.
cando.en.a2.u26.review: Anaweza kuunganisha katika masimulizi moja kilichotokea, kinachohitajika, na anachofurahia kufanya.
cando.en.a2.u27.my-year: Anaweza kutoa masimulizi mafupi ya mdomo na maandishi kuhusu mwaka wake: kilichotokea, kilichobadilika, na kinachofuata.

cando.en.b1.u01.past-habits: Anaweza kuelezea tabia na ratiba za zamani ambazo si za kweli tena, akitumia used to na would.
cando.en.b1.u01.story: Anaweza kusimulia hadithi inayounganisha maelezo ya mandhari na matukio yaliyotokea, kwa mpangilio.
cando.en.b1.u02.order: Anaweza kupanga matukio mawili ya zamani kwa mpangilio, akionyesha lililotokea kwanza.
cando.en.b1.u02.what-had-happened: Anaweza kusema kilichokwisha tokea kabla ya kutambua jambo fulani.
cando.en.b1.u03.duration: Anaweza kusema muda gani jambo limekuwa likiendelea, akitumia for na since.
cando.en.b1.u03.result-or-activity: Anaweza kutofautisha matokeo yaliyokamilika na shughuli ambayo huenda bado inaendelea.
cando.en.b1.u04.articles: Anaweza kutumia kanuni za kina za viambishi — the na kilinganishi cha juu zaidi au kitu cha pekee, bila kiambishi kwa milo na lugha, a/an kwa kazi na viwango.
cando.en.b1.u04.best-ever: Anaweza kupima uzoefu kuwa bora au mbaya zaidi akitumia kilinganishi cha juu zaidi pamoja na wakati uliopo timilifu na ever.
cando.en.b1.u05.future-in-progress: Anaweza kuelezea atakachokuwa akifanya wakati fulani maalum ujao.
cando.en.b1.u05.suggestions-offers: Anaweza kutoa mapendekezo na ofa kwa Shall we na Shall I.
cando.en.b1.u06.hypotheticals: Anaweza kudhania wakati uliopo au ujao usio halisi kwa if pamoja na umbo la wakati uliopita na would, na kutoa sababu.
cando.en.b1.u06.real-or-imagined: Anaweza kutofautisha uwezekano halisi na ule wa kudhania, akichagua kati ya if na will na if na would.
cando.en.b1.u07.if-only: Anaweza kuongeza nguvu kwa tamaa na kuifanya ya kina zaidi akitumia if only.
cando.en.b1.u07.wishes: Anaweza kuonyesha tamaa kuhusu jinsi mambo yalivyo sasa, akitumia wish pamoja na umbo la wakati uliopita kuonyesha si kweli.
cando.en.b1.u08.prepare-in-case: Anaweza kujiandaa kwa uwezekano fulani kwa in case, na kueleza sharti kwa as long as.
cando.en.b1.u08.warn-unless: Anaweza kuonya kuhusu tokeo linalotegemea sharti fulani, akitumia unless.
cando.en.b1.u09.deduction: Anaweza kupima jinsi jambo lilivyo na uhakika na kueleza ushahidi, akitumia must, might, na can't be.
cando.en.b1.u10.obligation-past: Anaweza kusema alichopaswa kufanya zamani na atakachopaswa kufanya baadaye.
cando.en.b1.u10.permission-any-tense: Anaweza kuzungumzia kilichoruhusiwa au kisichoruhusiwa, katika wakati wowote.
cando.en.b1.u11.made-or-let: Anaweza kusema alilazimishwa au aliruhusiwa kufanya nini na mtu, na analazimisha au kuruhusu wengine kufanya nini.
cando.en.b1.u11.want-someone-to: Anaweza kusema anachotaka, kuomba, kuambia, au kutarajia mtu mwingine afanye.
cando.en.b1.u12.processes: Anaweza kueleza jinsi kitu kinavyotengenezwa, kinavyotumika, au kinavyozalishwa, bila kuhitaji kusema nani anayekifanya, akitumia hali tendwa ya wakati uliopo.
cando.en.b1.u13.built: Anaweza kuelezea lini na jinsi kitu kilivyojengwa, kutengenezwa, kuandikwa, au kugunduliwa, akitumia hali tendwa ya wakati uliopita.
cando.en.b1.u13.passive-by: Anaweza kuongeza mtendaji katika sentensi ya hali tendwa ya wakati uliopita kwa by, tu pale maelezo hayo ni muhimu.
cando.en.b1.u14.report-speech: Anaweza kuripoti aliyoyasema mtu, akirudisha wakati nyuma ipasavyo.
cando.en.b1.u14.say-or-tell: Anaweza kuchagua kwa usahihi kati ya say na tell anaporipoti usemi.
cando.en.b1.u15.reported-questions: Anaweza kuripoti aliyouliza mtu, akihifadhi maswali ya ndiyo/hapana kwa if au whether na maswali ya wh- kwa mpangilio wa kauli tambarare.
cando.en.b1.u15.reported-requests: Anaweza kuripoti alichoambiwa au kuombwa afanye mtu, akitumia tell au ask pamoja na shamirisho na to-infinitive.
cando.en.b1.u16.drop-relative: Anaweza kuacha who, which, au that linapokuwa shamirisho la maelezo yaliyoongezwa, kama katika "the neighborhood I love."
cando.en.b1.u16.where-whose: Anaweza kubainisha mahali kwa where palipo, au mtu kwa whose kitu fulani ni chake, kama katika "the street where I live" na "a neighbor whose garden is full of flowers."
cando.en.b1.u17.verb-pattern-contrast: Anaweza kuchagua kwa usahihi kati ya -ing na to baada ya remember, stop, na try, na kujua jinsi maana inavyobadilika.
cando.en.b1.u17.verb-pattern-more: Anaweza kutumia -ing baada ya suggest, avoid, mind, na keep.
cando.en.b1.u18.phrasal-idioms: Anaweza kutumia jozi za kawaida za phrasal verbs ambazo maana yake haidhihiriki kutokana na sehemu zake — find out, give up, run out — kutatua tatizo la kila siku.
cando.en.b1.u18.phrasal-separable: Anaweza kuweka kiwakilishi katikati ya phrasal verb inayoweza kutenganishwa ya kila siku, kama turn it on au put it away.
cando.en.b1.u19.linking: Anaweza kuunganisha mawazo baina ya sentensi kwa however, therefore, na instead kufanya ulinganisho au kutoa hitimisho.
cando.en.b1.u19.purpose: Anaweza kueleza kusudi kwa undani zaidi, akitumia in order to na so that.
cando.en.b1.u20.echoes: Anaweza kukubaliana na aliyoyasema mtu kwa kurudia kitenzi chake kwa so au neither.
cando.en.b1.u20.tags: Anaweza kuthibitisha au kuhakiki jambo kwa kiambatanisho kifupi cha swali mwishoni.
cando.en.b1.u21.indefinites: Anaweza kuzungumzia watu, vitu, na mahali visivyobainishwa, akichanganya kwa usahihi maneno ya some-, any-, no-, na every-.
cando.en.b1.u22.reactions: Anaweza kuitikia jambo alilotazama au kusikia na kueleza kwa nini, akichagua kwa usahihi kati ya maumbo ya kivumishi ya -ed na -ing.
cando.en.b1.u23.results: Anaweza kueleza matokeo yaliyojengwa ndani ya maelezo — too slow to catch it, so strong that it broke, such a close game — akitumia too...to, so...that, na such a.
cando.en.b1.u24.indirect-questions: Anaweza kuomba taarifa kwa heshima, akilainisha swali kwa Could you tell me, Do you know, au I was wondering.
cando.en.b1.u25.pairs: Anaweza kusema kama jambo ni kweli kwa watu au vitu viwili pamoja, kimoja tu kati yao, au wala kimoja, akitumia both, either, na neither.
cando.en.b1.u25.preferences: Anaweza kusema anapendelea zaidi kipi kati ya vitu viwili, na kuuliza wengine wangependelea kipi.
cando.en.b1.u26.work-life: Anaweza kuzungumzia kazi, taaluma, na wenzake kazini, na kusimulia mahojiano ya kazi kutoka pande zote mbili — akijibu maswali na kuripoti kilichoulizwa na kusemwa.
cando.en.b1.u27.big-questions: Anaweza kuchukua msimamo kuhusu swali kubwa, kuunga mkono kwa dhana na sababu, na kuunganisha mawazo kwa however/therefore na dokezo.
cando.en.b1.u28.review: Anaweza kuunganisha katika masimulizi moja hadithi, hali za kudhania, aliyoyasema mtu mwingine, na maoni yake mwenyewe.
cando.en.b1.u29.five-stories: Anaweza kutoa mkusanyiko mfupi wa mdomo na maandishi: masimulizi ya wakati uliopita yenye tukio moja la wakati uliopita timilifu, hali ya kudhania, mazungumzo yaliyoripotiwa, maelezo ya mchakato kwa hali tendwa, na maoni yenye viunganishi vya mazungumzo.

gn.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.note: Umbo la -ing linaeleza kinachosababisha hisia; umbo la -ed linaeleza hisia yenyewe: "the film is boring, so I'm bored."
gn.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.title: -ed au -ing (vivumishi)
gn.en.gn.adv-degree.note: Very, really, quite, na too huwekwa kabla ya kivumishi kukiongeza au kukipunguza nguvu: "really tired, quite good, too late."
gn.en.gn.adv-degree.title: Vielezi vya kiwango
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.note: Maneno kama usually, often, na sometimes yanaeleza mara kwa mara tabia inafanyika. Huwekwa kabla ya kitenzi kikuu na baada ya be: "I usually walk. She is often late."
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.title: Vielezi vya marudio
gn.en.gn.adv-manner.note: Ongeza -ly kueleza jinsi tendo linavyofanyika: "She speaks slowly." Vichache huhifadhi umbo lake asili — well, fast, hard.
gn.en.gn.adv-manner.title: Vielezi vya jinsi
gn.en.gn.art-the.note: "The" inamaanisha kile tunachokijua sote: "the station", "the sun", au kutajwa kwa mara ya pili. Wingi wa jumla huacha the: "I like dogs."
gn.en.gn.art-the.title: the (msingi)
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: Tumia "a" kabla ya sauti za konsonanti na "an" kabla ya sauti za irabu: a book, an apple, an hour. Huashiria kitu kimoja, kisicho maalum.
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.title: a / an
gn.en.gn.articles-deep.note: The huashiria kitu cha pekee, kilinganishi cha juu zaidi, au mto; kiambishi hakiwekwi kwa milo, lugha, na barabara nyingi; a au an hutumika kwa kazi na viwango: "the fastest, breakfast, twice a day."
gn.en.gn.articles-deep.title: Viambishi: kanuni za kina
gn.en.gn.as-as.note: "As … as" huashiria vitu viwili kuwa sawa (as tall as me), na "not as … as" huashiria kimoja kuwa duni: "It's not as cheap as before."
gn.en.gn.as-as.title: as … as
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: "Am" huenda na I, na "are" huenda na you: "I am Anna. You are my friend." Njia hizi mbili hutumika katika utambulisho wako wa kwanza.
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.title: be: I am / you are
gn.en.gn.be-all.note: Am, is, na are kwa nafsi zote: he, she, na it huchukua "is"; we, you, na they huchukua "are". "She is a doctor. They are from Peru."
gn.en.gn.be-all.title: be: wakati uliopo kamili
gn.en.gn.be-allowed-to.note: "Be allowed to" huelezea ruhusa katika wakati wowote: "We weren't allowed to talk in class. You're allowed to park here."
gn.en.gn.be-allowed-to.title: be allowed to
gn.en.gn.be-neg.note: Ongeza "not" baada ya be: "I am not tired. She isn't here." Njia fupi isn't na aren't husikika asilia zaidi katika mazungumzo.
gn.en.gn.be-neg.title: be: kukanusha
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: Geuza be iwe mbele: "You are tired." inakuwa "Are you tired?" Mpangilio wa maneno pekee huifanya iwe swali — hakuna neno la ziada linalohitajika.
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.title: Maswali ya Ndiyo/Hapana na be
gn.en.gn.can-ability.note: "I can swim. He can't drive." Njia moja kwa kila nafsi, na kitenzi kinachofuata hubaki katika hali yake ya asili.
gn.en.gn.can-ability.title: can / can't (uwezo)
gn.en.gn.can-request.note: "Can I have the menu? Can you help me?" — ombi la heshima la kila siku, kwa ruhusa na msaada.
gn.en.gn.can-request.title: can (maombi)
gn.en.gn.comp-adverbs.note: Kulinganisha jinsi kitu kinavyofanyika, tumia more, -er, au umbo lisilo la kawaida pamoja na than: "She types more quickly. He runs faster. They play better than us."
gn.en.gn.comp-adverbs.title: Vielezi vya kulinganisha
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.note: Vivumishi vifupi huchukua -er na -est (older, the oldest); virefu hutumia more na most. Good inakuwa better na best. Linganisha na "than": "My city is bigger than yours."
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.title: Vilinganishi na vishirikishi
gn.en.gn.cond-first-vs-second.note: Sharti la kwanza hupima mpango unaowezekana; la pili hudhania jambo lisilowezekana sana: "If it rains, we'll stay in" dhidi ya "If I won the lottery, I'd travel."
gn.en.gn.cond-first-vs-second.title: Halisi au la kudhania?
gn.en.gn.cond-first.note: If pamoja na wakati uliopo, will, kwa uwezekano halisi wa baadaye: "If it rains, we'll stay in." Will hubaki nje ya sehemu ya if.
gn.en.gn.cond-first.title: Sharti la kwanza
gn.en.gn.cond-second.note: If pamoja na umbo la wakati uliopita, kisha would pamoja na kitenzi, hudhania wakati uliopo au ujao usio halisi: "If I had more time, I would travel."
gn.en.gn.cond-second.title: Sharti la pili
gn.en.gn.cond-zero.note: If pamoja na wakati uliopo, wakati uliopo, kwa mambo ambayo ni kweli kwa ujumla: "If you heat ice, it melts." Sehemu zote mbili hubaki katika wakati uliopo.
gn.en.gn.cond-zero.title: Sharti sifuri
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.note: Unganisha mawazo: "I like tea and coffee. It's small but nice. I stayed home because I was tired."
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.title: and / but / because
gn.en.gn.conn-discourse.note: However, therefore, na instead huunganisha sentensi moja na inayofuata: "It was late. However, we kept going."
gn.en.gn.conn-discourse.title: however / therefore / instead
gn.en.gn.could-past-polite.note: Could hurudi nyuma kwenye uwezo wa zamani ("I could swim at five") na hulainisha ombi la wakati huu ("Could you help me?").
gn.en.gn.could-past-polite.title: could
gn.en.gn.count-uncount.note: Baadhi ya nomino — water, money, rice — hutendewa kama wingi usiogawanyika: hazichukui -s ya wingi wala "a" mbele yake. Nyingine huhesabiwa moja baada ya nyingine kama kawaida.
gn.en.gn.count-uncount.title: Vinavyohesabika na visivyohesabika
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.note: "This" huashiria kitu kilicho karibu nawe na "that" huashiria kitu kilicho mbali zaidi: "This is my phone. That is your bag."
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.title: this / that
gn.en.gn.do-neg.note: "I don't know. She doesn't eat meat." Don't au doesn't pamoja na kitenzi asilia — -s huhamia kwenye "does" na kuacha kitenzi.
gn.en.gn.do-neg.title: Kukanusha na don't/doesn't
gn.en.gn.do-quest.note: "Do you like tea? Does she work here?" Do au does huanzisha swali na kitenzi kikuu hubaki katika hali yake ya asili.
gn.en.gn.do-quest.title: Maswali na do/does
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.note: English inahitaji kiima hata kwa hali ya hewa na wakati: "It is raining. It's cold. It's late." "It" haiashirii chochote — inajaza tu nafasi ya kiima.
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.title: it kwa hali ya hewa na wakati
gn.en.gn.echo-so-neither.note: Kubali kwa kurudia kitenzi kisaidizi: "I love it." "So do I." Marudio chanya hutumia so; hasi hutumia neither.
gn.en.gn.echo-so-neither.title: So do I / Neither do I
gn.en.gn.few-little.note: A few huenda na nomino zinazohesabika na a little na zisizohesabika; ondoa "a" na few au little huashiria kutokutosha: "a few friends" dhidi ya "few friends."
gn.en.gn.few-little.title: (a) few / (a) little
gn.en.gn.for-since.note: For hupima urefu wa muda (for two years); since hutaja mwanzo wake (since 2020). Zote mbili huambatana kiasili na wakati uliopo timilifu.
gn.en.gn.for-since.title: for / since
gn.en.gn.future-cont.note: Will be pamoja na -ing huchora tendo linaloendelea wakati fulani ujao: "This time tomorrow I'll be flying."
gn.en.gn.future-cont.title: Wakati ujao endelevu
gn.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.note: Baada ya like, love, hate, enjoy, mind, na stop, kitenzi kinachofuata huchukua -ing: "I enjoy cooking. Do you mind waiting?"
gn.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.title: kitenzi + -ing
gn.en.gn.going-to.note: Be pamoja na going to pamoja na kitenzi kwa mipango: "I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow. We're going to travel in June."
gn.en.gn.going-to.title: going to (mipango)
gn.en.gn.had-to.note: Wajibu husogea kwa wakati: "I had to wear a uniform" hurejea nyuma, "You'll have to book early" hutazama mbele.
gn.en.gn.had-to.title: had to / will have to
gn.en.gn.have-got.note: Umiliki: "I have two brothers. She has a car." Unaweza pia kusikia "have got" — ichukulie kama ina maana sawa.
gn.en.gn.have-got.title: have / has
gn.en.gn.have-to.note: Have to huonyesha wajibu; don't have to huonyesha hakuna wajibu — si kwamba jambo limekatazwa: "I have to work" dhidi ya "You don't have to come."
gn.en.gn.have-to.title: have to / don't have to
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.note: "How many" na vitu vinavyohesabika ("How many apples?") na "how much" na visivyohesabika ("How much water?"). Bei hutumia "How much is it?"
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.title: How much / How many
gn.en.gn.if-only.note: "If only" huongeza nguvu kwa tamaa na kuifanya ya kina zaidi: "If only it were warmer." Hutumia muundo ule ule wa wakati uliopita kama wish.
gn.en.gn.if-only.title: If only
gn.en.gn.imperatives.note: Mwambie mtu afanye nini kwa kutumia kitenzi asilia: "Turn left. Wait here. Please don't stop." Kuongeza "please" huifanya iwe ya kirafiki.
gn.en.gn.imperatives.title: Amri
gn.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.note: In case huandaa kwa uwezekano ("take an umbrella in case it rains"); as long as huweka sharti ("you can stay as long as you're quiet").
gn.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.title: in case / as long as
gn.en.gn.in-order-to.note: "In order to" na "so that" hueleza kusudi kwa undani zaidi: "in order to save time, so that everyone can hear."
gn.en.gn.in-order-to.title: in order to / so that
gn.en.gn.indef-pronouns.note: Unganisha some-, any-, no-, na every- na body, thing, na where, ukifuata mfumo ule ule wa some/any: "someone called, but nobody answered."
gn.en.gn.indef-pronouns.title: somebody / anything / nowhere
gn.en.gn.indirect-questions.note: Ndani ya muundo wa heshima, swali la ndani halibadilishi mpangilio: "Where is the station?" inakuwa "Could you tell me where the station is?"
gn.en.gn.indirect-questions.title: Could you tell me where…?
gn.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.note: Baada ya want, need, hope, decide, na would like, kitenzi kinachofuata huchukua "to": "I want to go. She decided to stay."
gn.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.title: kitenzi + to-infinitive
gn.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.note: "To + kitenzi" hujibu kwa nini ulifanya kitu: "I came to help." Hubeba maana ya "in order to."
gn.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.title: Infinitive ya kusudi
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: Kitenzi pamoja na kitu, hakuna kitu katikati: "I like coffee. I want water." Mtu anayependa ndiye kiima.
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.title: like / want + nomino
gn.en.gn.make-let.note: Baada ya make na let, shamirisho hufuatwa na kitenzi bila "to": "They made us wait. She let me drive."
gn.en.gn.make-let.title: make / let + kitenzi bila to
gn.en.gn.might-may.note: Might na may huashiria uwezekano, si uhakika: "It might rain. She may be late." Zote mbili huacha matokeo wazi.
gn.en.gn.might-may.title: might / may
gn.en.gn.modal-deduction.note: Vitenzi visaidizi vya kimodali huweza kupima jinsi ulivyo na uhakika: "It must be cold out. She can't be home yet. He might be busy." Kitenzi huakisi ushahidi uliopo.
gn.en.gn.modal-deduction.title: must / might / can't be
gn.en.gn.much-many-alot.note: Many huenda na nomino zinazohesabika, much na zisizohesabika, na a lot of hufaa vyote viwili kwa urahisi: "many books, much time, a lot of either."
gn.en.gn.much-many-alot.title: much / many / a lot of
gn.en.gn.must-mustnt.note: Must huashiria sheria kali; mustn't huashiria kukatazwa, jambo tofauti na don't have to: "You mustn't park here."
gn.en.gn.must-mustnt.title: must / mustn't
gn.en.gn.narrative-tenses.note: Hadithi huunganisha wakati uliopita rahisi kwa matukio, uliopita endelevu kwa mandhari ya nyuma, na viunganishi kama first, then, na finally kuisogeza mbele: "I was walking home when I saw her, so I stopped."
gn.en.gn.narrative-tenses.title: Kusimulia hadithi kwa wakati uliopita
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.note: Hesabu hadi mia moja na zingatia mtego wa -teen dhidi ya -ty: thirteen na thirty husikika karibu, hivyo mkazo huwatofautisha.
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.title: Namba 1–100
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Me, you, him, her, it, us, them — huja baada ya kitenzi: "Call me. I see her. Ask him."
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.title: Viwakilishi vya shamirisho
gn.en.gn.passive-by.note: Taja mtendaji kwa "by" pale tu maelezo hayo ndiyo habari muhimu: "It was painted by my sister." Vinginevyo hali tendwa huweza kuyaacha.
gn.en.gn.passive-by.title: by + mtendaji
gn.en.gn.passive-past.note: Hali tendwa ya wakati uliopita huunganisha was au were na kitenzi cha wakati timilifu: "The bridge was built in 1900. The letters were sent yesterday."
gn.en.gn.passive-past.title: Hali tendwa ya wakati uliopita
gn.en.gn.passive-present.note: Be pamoja na kitenzi cha wakati timilifu husogeza mkazo kwenye kinachofanyika badala ya nani anayekifanya: "Rice is grown here." Mtendaji anaweza kubaki bila kutajwa.
gn.en.gn.passive-present.title: Hali tendwa ya wakati uliopo
gn.en.gn.past-be.note: Wakati uliopita wa be: I, he, she, na it huchukua "was"; you, we, na they huchukua "were". "I was at home. They were happy."
gn.en.gn.past-be.title: was / were
gn.en.gn.past-cont.note: Tumia was au were pamoja na kitenzi-ing kwa jambo lililokuwa likiendelea wakati fulani uliopita: "I was cooking when you called." Huweka mandhari badala ya kuripoti tukio lililokamilika.
gn.en.gn.past-cont.title: Wakati uliopita endelevu
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.note: Vitenzi vya kawaida hubadilisha umbo katika wakati uliopita: go na went, have na had, see na saw, do na did, get na got, make na made.
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.title: Wakati uliopita usio wa kawaida (vitenzi vikuu)
gn.en.gn.past-perfect-vs-past.note: Wakati uliopita timilifu huashiria tukio lililotokea kwanza; baada ya before, after, au by the time, mpangilio mara nyingi huwa dhahiri wenyewe: "After she left, we ate."
gn.en.gn.past-perfect-vs-past.title: Mpangilio wa matukio ya wakati uliopita
gn.en.gn.past-perfect.note: Had pamoja na kitenzi cha wakati timilifu huashiria tukio la mapema kati ya matukio mawili ya wakati uliopita: "The train had left when I arrived." Hurudi nyuma zaidi hatua moja.
gn.en.gn.past-perfect.title: Wakati uliopita timilifu
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.note: "Did you see it? I didn't go." Did hubeba wakati uliopita, hivyo kitenzi kikuu hurudi katika hali yake ya asili.
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.title: did: maswali na kukanusha
gn.en.gn.past-reg.note: Ongeza -ed kwa vitendo vilivyokamilika: "I worked. She visited her mother." Umbo hilo hilo hufanya kazi kwa kila nafsi.
gn.en.gn.past-reg.title: Wakati uliopita rahisi: -ed
gn.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.note: Tendo refu la nyuma (was au were + -ing) mara nyingi hukatizwa na jingine la haraka la wakati uliopita rahisi, likiunganishwa na when au while: "I was reading when the lights went out."
gn.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.title: Wakati uliopita uliokatizwa
gn.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.note: "I've painted the room" huonyesha matokeo yaliyokamilika; "I've been painting" huonyesha shughuli, ambayo huenda bado inaendelea. Moja hupima matokeo, nyingine juhudi.
gn.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.title: Matokeo au muda?
gn.en.gn.phrasal-separable.note: Baadhi ya phrasal verbs hugawanyika kuzunguka shamirisho, na kiwakilishi huketi katikati: "turn the light on" au "turn it on."
gn.en.gn.phrasal-separable.title: Phrasal verbs zinazoweza kutenganishwa
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-1.note: Kitenzi pamoja na kipande kidogo huweza kubadilisha maana: get up, turn on, look for, put on. Jozi hiyo hufanya kazi kama wazo moja.
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-1.title: Phrasal verbs I
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-2.note: Jozi nyingine za kila siku — find out, give up, carry on, look after, run out of, sort out — hubeba maana usizoweza kuzikisia kutoka sehemu zake.
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-2.title: Phrasal verbs II
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: Baadhi ya nomino hubadilika badala ya kuongeza -s: man na men, woman na women, child na children, person na people, foot na feet.
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.title: Wingi usio wa kawaida
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.note: Ongeza -s kwa zaidi ya moja, au -es baada ya s, sh, ch, na x: one cat, two cats; one box, two boxes.
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.title: Wingi wa kawaida
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.note: My, your, his, her, its, our, their — viweke kabla ya nomino: "her book", "our house", "their names".
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.title: Vivumishi vya umiliki
gn.en.gn.poss-pron.note: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, na theirs husimama peke yake bila nomino baada yake: "That book is mine."
gn.en.gn.poss-pron.title: Viwakilishi vya umiliki
gn.en.gn.poss-s.note: Ongeza 's kwa mmiliki: "Anna's dog", "my brother's car". English huweka mmiliki kwanza na kitu kinachomilikiwa pili.
gn.en.gn.poss-s.title: Umiliki 's
gn.en.gn.prep-movement.note: Into, out of, through, across, along, past, na over huelezea mwelekeo wa safari badala ya mahali maalum: "walk through the park, across the bridge."
gn.en.gn.prep-movement.title: Viunganishi vya mwendo
gn.en.gn.prep-place.note: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between — maneno madogo yanayoelezea mahali: "The keys are on the table."
gn.en.gn.prep-place.title: Viunganishi vya mahali
gn.en.gn.pres-cont-future.note: Wakati uliopo endelevu unaweza kuashiria mpango uliopangwa na wakati maalum: "I'm meeting Ana at six." Neno la wakati huzuia lisisikike kama sasa hivi.
gn.en.gn.pres-cont-future.title: Wakati uliopo endelevu kwa mipango
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.note: Be pamoja na kitenzi-ing kwa sasa hivi: "I am eating. They are working. Look, it is raining."
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.title: Wakati uliopo endelevu
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.note: "Has been to" humaanisha alikwenda na kurudi; "has gone to" humaanisha bado yupo huko: "She has been to Paris" dhidi ya "She has gone to Paris."
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.title: been dhidi ya gone
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.note: Have au has been pamoja na -ing huelezea tendo linaloendelea au lililokoma hivi punde: "I've been waiting for an hour." Hutegemea urefu wa shughuli.
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.title: Wakati uliopo timilifu endelevu
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.note: Have au has pamoja na kitenzi cha wakati timilifu huzungumzia uzoefu wa maisha bila kusema lini: "I have visited Rome." Wakati si muhimu — uzoefu ndio muhimu.
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.title: Wakati uliopo timilifu: uzoefu
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.note: Neno la wakati uliokamilika (yesterday, last week) huhitaji wakati uliopita rahisi; wakati usiokamilika au usiotajwa hutegemea wakati uliopo timilifu. "I saw it yesterday" lakini "I have seen it."
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.title: Wakati uliopo timilifu dhidi ya uliopita rahisi
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.note: Already huashiria jambo lililofanyika mapema kuliko ilivyotarajiwa, yet huuliza au hukanusha katika maswali na ukanushaji, na just huashiria wakati uliopita wa karibu sana: "I've just eaten. Have you finished yet?"
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.title: already / yet / just
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: Na he, she, na it, kitenzi huchukua -s: "She works. He watches." Ni herufi inayofahamika kidogo katika English, hivyo ipe umakini wa ziada.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.title: Nafsi ya 3 -s
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: Kwa tabia na ukweli, tumia kitenzi asilia: "I work at home. They live in Lima." Hakuna mabadiliko ya viishio kwa viima hivi.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.title: Wakati uliopo rahisi: I / you / we / they
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.note: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. English inataka kiima kitajwe kwa sauti katika karibu kila sentensi — "am tired" inahitaji "I" yake.
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.title: Viwakilishi vya kiima
gn.en.gn.question-tags.note: Kiambatanisho cha swali hurudia kitenzi kisaidizi na kukigeuza kinyume: "It's cold, isn't it? You don't mind, do you?"
gn.en.gn.question-tags.title: Question tags
gn.en.gn.question-words-deep.note: Neno la swali linapokuwa kiima, achana na do: "Who called you?" Linapokuwa shamirisho, litumie: "Who did you call?" Linganisha na "What happened?"
gn.en.gn.question-words-deep.title: Maswali ya kiima na ya shamirisho
gn.en.gn.reflexive.note: Kiima na shamirisho vinapokuwa kitu kile kile, tumia myself, yourself, herself, na vinginevyo: "I hurt myself. Help yourselves."
gn.en.gn.reflexive.title: Viwakilishi vya kujirejea
gn.en.gn.rel-object-omit.note: Neno la kurejea linapokuwa shamirisho, English inakuruhusu kuliacha: "the film we watched" hufanya kazi sawa na "the film that we watched."
gn.en.gn.rel-object-omit.title: Kuacha kirejeshi
gn.en.gn.rel-where-whose.note: Where huashiria mahali na whose mmiliki: "the town where I grew up, the writer whose book won."
gn.en.gn.rel-where-whose.title: Virejeshi: where / whose
gn.en.gn.rel-who-which.note: Tumia who kwa watu na which au that kwa vitu kuongeza maelezo muhimu: "the man who lives here, the bag that fits."
gn.en.gn.rel-who-which.title: Sentensi za kirejeshi (za kubainisha)
gn.en.gn.reported-commands.note: Ripoti ombi au amri kwa tell au ask pamoja na shamirisho na to-infinitive: "She told me to wait. He asked us not to call."
gn.en.gn.reported-commands.title: Maombi na amri katika usemi wa taarifa
gn.en.gn.reported-questions.note: Maswali ya taarifa huacha mpangilio wa swali na kusomeka kama kauli: "Where do you live?" inakuwa "He asked where I lived." Tumia if au whether kwa yale ya ndiyo-hapana.
gn.en.gn.reported-questions.title: Maswali katika usemi wa taarifa
gn.en.gn.reported-statements.note: Kuripoti aliyosema mtu, rudisha wakati nyuma hatua moja: "I'm tired" inakuwa "She said (that) she was tired."
gn.en.gn.reported-statements.title: Usemi wa taarifa: kauli
gn.en.gn.say-vs-tell.note: Tell inahitaji mtu mara moja baada yake (tell me); say haihitaji (say that…): "She told me the news" lakini "She said the news was good."
gn.en.gn.say-vs-tell.title: say / tell
gn.en.gn.shall-suggest.note: Shall pamoja na I au we hutoa ofa au pendekezo: "Shall we start? Shall I open the window?"
gn.en.gn.shall-suggest.title: Shall we…?
gn.en.gn.should-advice.note: Should na shouldn't hutoa ushauri au maoni, ikifuatwa na kitenzi bila to: "You should rest. You shouldn't skip breakfast."
gn.en.gn.should-advice.title: should / shouldn't
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: "I drink coffee every day" ni tabia; "I am drinking coffee" ni wakati huu. Maneno ya wakati ndiyo dalili yako.
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.title: Tabia au sasa hivi?
gn.en.gn.so-because-although.note: So huanzisha matokeo, because sababu, na although tofauti: "It was late, so we left. We stayed because it was warm, although it rained."
gn.en.gn.so-because-although.title: so / because / although
gn.en.gn.some-any.note: "Some" katika sentensi chanya ("I have some money") na "any" katika kukanusha na maswali ("Do you have any money?").
gn.en.gn.some-any.title: some / any
gn.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.note: Kilinganishi cha juu zaidi huungana na wakati uliopo timilifu na ever kupima uzoefu: "It's the best film I have ever seen."
gn.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.title: The best I've ever…
gn.en.gn.sv-order.note: Sentensi za English huenda Kiima–Kitenzi–Shamirisho: "I eat apples." Mpangilio hubeba maana, hivyo weka mtendaji kwanza na kitendo pili.
gn.en.gn.sv-order.title: Mpangilio wa maneno wa msingi
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.note: Kusema kitu kipo: "There is a bank. There are two cafes." Linganisha is au are na idadi ya vitu unavyomaanisha.
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.title: there is / there are
gn.en.gn.time-clauses.note: Baada ya when, as soon as, before, au after, English hutumia wakati uliopo kwa maana ya baadaye: "When I arrive, I'll call you" — si "when I will arrive."
gn.en.gn.time-clauses.title: Sentensi za wakati za baadaye
gn.en.gn.time-prep.note: "At" kwa saa (at five), "on" kwa siku na tarehe (on Monday), "in" kwa miezi, miaka, na sehemu za siku (in May, in the morning).
gn.en.gn.time-prep.title: at / on / in kwa wakati
gn.en.gn.time-telling.note: Anza na "It's": "It's three o'clock. It's half past two. It's seven fifteen." "It" hubaki hata kama hakuna kitu kilichotajwa.
gn.en.gn.time-telling.title: Kueleza saa
gn.en.gn.too-enough.note: Too kabla ya kivumishi husema zaidi ya unavyotaka (too hot); enough huja baada ya kivumishi lakini kabla ya nomino (warm enough, enough time).
gn.en.gn.too-enough.title: too / enough
gn.en.gn.too-to-so-that.note: "Too … to" na "so … that" hujenga matokeo ndani ya kivumishi: "too tired to drive, so tired that I slept."
gn.en.gn.too-to-so-that.title: too…to / so…that
gn.en.gn.unless.note: Unless humaanisha if…not: "We'll miss it unless we leave now." Neno moja hubeba sharti lote la ukanushaji.
gn.en.gn.unless.title: unless
gn.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.note: Zote used to na would hurudia matendo ya zamani yaliyojirudia: "We would swim every summer." Hata hivyo, kwa hali za zamani, used to hutumika na would hapana.
gn.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.title: used to / would (tabia za zamani)
gn.en.gn.used-to.note: "Used to" hueleza tabia au hali ya zamani isiyoendelea tena: "I used to live in Lima." Kitenzi kinachofuata hubaki katika umbo lake asili — used to live, si used to lived.
gn.en.gn.used-to.title: used to
gn.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.note: Vitenzi kama want, ask, tell, na expect huchukua shamirisho kisha to-infinitive: "I want you to listen. She asked me to wait."
gn.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.title: want someone to do
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.note: Na remember, stop, na try, muundo hubadilisha maana: "stop smoking" (kuacha) dhidi ya "stop to smoke" (kusimama ili kuvuta).
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.title: remember / stop / try + -ing au to
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-more.note: Suggest, avoid, mind, na keep zote huchukua -ing: "I suggest leaving early. Keep trying. I don't mind waiting."
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-more.title: suggest / avoid / mind / keep
gn.en.gn.verb-prep-collocations.note: Baadhi ya vitenzi husafiri na kiunganishi maalum: listen to, wait for, look at, depend on. Inafaa kujifunza jozi nzima.
gn.en.gn.verb-prep-collocations.title: kitenzi + kiunganishi
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: What, where, who, au how, kisha be, kisha kiima: "Where are you? What is this? Who is that?"
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.title: Maswali ya Wh- na be
gn.en.gn.will-decide-offer.note: Tumia will unapoamua, kutoa ofa, au kuahidi wakati unaozungumza: "I'll help you. I'll get it." Uamuzi hufanywa papo hapo.
gn.en.gn.will-decide-offer.title: will (maamuzi na ofa)
gn.en.gn.will-predict.note: Will pamoja na kitenzi bila to huonyesha utabiri au ukweli kuhusu baadaye: "It will rain later." Umbo hilo halibadiliki kutoka nafsi moja hadi nyingine.
gn.en.gn.will-predict.title: will (utabiri)
gn.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.note: Going to hufaa mpango uliokwisha pangwa au ushahidi unaouona; will hufaa utabiri au uamuzi wa papo hapo: "We're going to paint" dhidi ya "I'll paint it."
gn.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.title: will dhidi ya going to
gn.en.gn.wish-past.note: Matamanio kuhusu wakati uliopo hutumia umbo la wakati uliopita: "I wish I had a garden. I wish I could stay." Umbo la wakati uliopita huashiria kuwa si hivyo.
gn.en.gn.wish-past.title: wish + wakati uliopita
gn.en.gn.would-like-offers.note: "Would you like…?" hutoa ofa kwa heshima na "I'd like…" huomba kitu kwa upole: "Would you like a coffee? I'd like to book a table."
gn.en.gn.would-like-offers.title: would you like…?
gn.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like a coffee, please" ndiyo njia ya heshima ya kuagiza au kuomba kitu — laini zaidi kuliko "I want".
gn.en.gn.would-like.title: I'd like (kwa heshima)
ovl.es.en.a1.u10.note: Angalia maneno ya Kiingereza yanayofanana kimwonekano lakini yenye maana tofauti: actually si "kwa sasa" (ni "kwa kweli"), assist si "kuhudhuria" (ni "kusaidia"), exit si "mafanikio" (ni "njia ya kutoka"), na carpet si "faili" (ni "zulia").
ovl.es.en.a1.u12.note: Vivumishi huja KABLA ya nomino na hayachukui -s ya wingi: "the red cars", si "the cars reds".
ovl.es.en.a1.u24.note: "Whose" hubeba peke yake kazi nzima ya kuuliza umiliki: "Whose is this?"
ovl.es.en.a2.u18.note: Angalia maneno yanayofanana kimwonekano unapozungumzia malengo: "pretend" humaanisha kujifanya (si kukusudia), na "intend" ndiyo humaanisha kukusudia au kulenga; "try" humaanisha kujaribu tu.
ovl.es.en.a2.u22.note: Unapotoa maoni, angalia tofauti kati ya "discuss" (kuzungumza kwa utulivu) na "argue" (kubishana kwa hisia kali).
ovl.es.en.b1.u03.note: Maneno ya kiafya yanayoweza kuchanganya: "constipated" ni tatizo la kuvimbiwa (si mafua), "molest" ni kunyanyasa kingono (si kusumbua tu), na "embarrassed" ni kuona aibu (si kuwa mjamzito).
ovl.es.en.b1.u22.note: Maneno yanayofanana kimwonekano lakini yenye maana tofauti: "argument" katika filamu ni ubishi (mtiririko wa hadithi ni plot), "success" ni mafanikio (tukio ni event), na "sensible" ni mwenye busara (mwenye hisia nyepesi ni sensitive).
ovl.es.en.b1.u26.note: Maneno ya kazi yanayofanana kimwonekano lakini yenye maana tofauti: "realize" ni kutambua (si kutekeleza), "support" ni kuunga mkono (si kuvumilia), "application" ni maombi ya kazi, na "compromise" ni maafikiano.
ovl.es.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.note: Lugha nyingi zina neno moja tu kwa hali hii; English inagawanya: umbo la -ing hutaja chanzo, umbo la -ed hutaja hisia yenyewe.
ovl.es.en.gn.adv-freq.note: Maneno haya ya marudio yanaweza kuhamahama katika lugha nyingine, lakini English huyaweka mahali maalum: kabla ya kitenzi kikuu na baada ya be: "I usually walk. She is often late."
ovl.es.en.gn.art-the.note: Kauli za jumla huacha "the" katika Kiingereza: "Life is beautiful" na "I like dogs" hazihitaji kiambishi.
ovl.es.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: Kiambishi "a/an" kinahitajika hata kwa taaluma ambazo lugha nyingine huziacha bila kiambishi: "I am an engineer."
ovl.es.en.gn.articles-deep.note: Baadhi ya lugha huweka kiambishi cha uhakika mbele ya majina ya lugha na nomino za jumla; Kiingereza kwa kawaida huviacha bila kiambishi: "English is useful."
ovl.es.en.gn.as-as.note: Maneno mawili ya "as" huzunguka kivumishi kuonyesha ulinganifu: "as tall as me".
ovl.es.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: Vitenzi tofauti vya "kuwa" katika baadhi ya lugha huungana kwenye kitenzi kimoja cha Kiingereza, be: "I am tall" na "I am tired" vyote hutumia am.
ovl.es.en.gn.be-all.note: Iwe unaelezea hali ya kudumu au ya muda, Kiingereza hutumia kitenzi kimoja tu: "the shop is open" na "the shop is small" vyote hutumia is.
ovl.es.en.gn.be-allowed-to.note: "Be allowed to" hubeba maana ya ruhusa katika wakati wowote: "I wasn't allowed to go out."
ovl.es.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: Baadhi ya lugha huuliza kwa kupandisha sauti tu; Kiingereza huhamisha be mbele ya sentensi: "Are you tired?" Toni pekee bila mpangilio huo husomeka kama kauli, si swali.
ovl.es.en.gn.can-ability.note: Uwezo uliojifunza na uwezekano au ruhusa vyote huwa "can" katika Kiingereza: "I can swim" na "I can go."
ovl.es.en.gn.comp-superl.note: Kulinganisha kwa "zaidi ya" hugawanyika Kiingereza: -er than kwa vivumishi vifupi (bigger than) na more...than kwa virefu — mgawanyo huu ndio sehemu mpya.
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-first.note: Katika sharti la kwanza, will hubaki nje ya sehemu ya if: "if it rains, we'll stay in" — si "if it will rain".
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-second.note: Katika sharti la pili, if hufuatwa na umbo la wakati uliopita, kisha would: "if I had time, I would travel." Would haiingii sehemu ya if.
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-zero.note: Sharti sifuri huwa rahisi: sehemu zote mbili hubaki katika wakati uliopo: "if you heat ice, it melts."
ovl.es.en.gn.conn-discourse.note: Vielezi vya kuunganisha kama however na therefore hufuatwa na koma: "It was late. However, we kept going."
ovl.es.en.gn.could-past-polite.note: Neno moja la uwezo katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza: uwezo wa zamani na ombi la heshima vyote huwa could. "I could swim" (zamani); "could you help?" (ombi).
ovl.es.en.gn.count-uncount.note: Nomino kadhaa zinazohesabika katika lugha nyingine hazihesabiki Kiingereza: information, furniture, money, bread, na advice haziwi na wingi wala "a". "A piece of advice" ndiyo njia ya kusema kipande kimoja.
ovl.es.en.gn.dem-sg.note: Lugha nyingine zina viwakilishi vitatu vya umbali; Kiingereza ina viwili tu: this (karibu) na that (mbali) — vyote viwili vya mbali zaidi huwa that.
ovl.es.en.gn.do-neg.note: Kiingereza hutumia ukanushaji mmoja tu: "I don't see anything" — don't pamoja na neno chanya, si ukanushaji maradufu.
ovl.es.en.gn.do-quest.note: Baadhi ya lugha huuliza kwa toni tu; Kiingereza huongeza do/does: "Do you like coffee?"
ovl.es.en.gn.dummy-it.note: Lugha nyingine huelezea hali ya hewa bila kiima; Kiingereza hudai kiima kila wakati: "IT is raining. IT's late. IT's cold." It haiashirii chochote — inajaza tu nafasi.
ovl.es.en.gn.echo-so-neither.note: Badala ya "mimi pia" isiyobadilika, Kiingereza hurudia kitenzi kisaidizi: "So am I", "Neither can I" — si "me too" tambarare.
ovl.es.en.gn.few-little.note: Neno moja la "kidogo" katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza kuwa little (visivyohesabika) na few (vinavyohesabika); ondoa "a" na vinaonyesha kutokutosha.
ovl.es.en.gn.for-since.note: Maneno mawili tofauti ya "tangu / kwa muda" hujificha ndani ya for na since: for hupima urefu (for two years), since huonyesha mwanzo (since 2020).
ovl.es.en.gn.future-cont.note: "I'll be flying" ni usemi wa kawaida kabisa katika Kiingereza, si rasmi. Itumie kwa uhuru kuonyesha tendo linaloendelea wakati fulani ujao.
ovl.es.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.note: Baada ya enjoy na mind, Kiingereza hutumia -ing pale ambapo lugha nyingine hutumia infinitive: "I like cooking."
ovl.es.en.gn.going-to.note: Muundo huu mara nyingi huwa sawa na lugha nyingine: "I'm going to travel" huelezea mpango ulio tayari akilini.
ovl.es.en.gn.had-to.note: Kama maswali mengine ya wakati uliopita, did hubeba wakati: "did you have to wait?", wakati kauli ni "I had to wait."
ovl.es.en.gn.have-got.note: Baadhi ya hisia zinazoelezwa kwa kitenzi "kuwa na" katika lugha nyingine hutumia be Kiingereza: "I AM hungry", "I AM thirsty", "I AM 20" — si have.
ovl.es.en.gn.have-to.note: "Don't have to" huonyesha hakuna wajibu, si kwamba jambo limekatazwa: "you don't have to come." Lisome kama uhuru, si kukatazwa.
ovl.es.en.gn.how-much-many.note: Kiingereza hugawanya swali la "kiasi gani" kulingana na uhesabikaji badala ya jinsia: how much (visivyohesabika) na how many (vinavyohesabika).
ovl.es.en.gn.imperatives.note: Baadhi ya lugha zina amri tofauti za heshima na za kawaida; Kiingereza ina amri moja kwa kila mtu. "Please" hubeba heshima hiyo.
ovl.es.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.note: "In case" hufuatwa na kitenzi cha wakati uliopo kuandaa uwezekano, na "as long as" huweka sharti: "take it in case it rains; stay as long as you like."
ovl.es.en.gn.indef-pronouns.note: Kiingereza huhifadhi ukanushaji mmoja tu: "I didn't see anybody" — si "didn't see nobody."
ovl.es.en.gn.indirect-questions.note: Ndani ya muundo wa heshima, swali la ndani halibadilishi mpangilio — kosa la kawaida kwa wanafunzi: "could you tell me where the station is?", si "where is the station?"
ovl.es.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.note: "To" si hiari katika Kiingereza baada ya vitenzi kama want, hata kama lugha nyingine huunganisha vitenzi moja kwa moja: "I want to go."
ovl.es.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.note: Kusudi huelezwa kwa "to + kitenzi", si "for + -ing": "to learn", si "for learning."
ovl.es.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: Mpangilio hubadilika Kiingereza: anayependa ndiye kiima: "I like tea." Hakuna neno la ziada mbele, wala kiambishi kwa vitu vya jumla.
ovl.es.en.gn.make-let.note: Make na let hufuatwa na shamirisho kisha kitenzi bila "to": "they made me wait", si "made me to wait."
ovl.es.en.gn.might-may.note: Might na may huonyesha kutokuwa na uhakika tu, si maana ya uwezo: "it might rain."
ovl.es.en.gn.modal-deduction.note: Kudokeza kwa uhakika mkubwa hutumia must be: "he must be tired." Kudokeza hasi hutumia can't be, si mustn't be.
ovl.es.en.gn.much-many-alot.note: Neno moja la "nyingi" katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza kuwa much na many, huku a lot of ikifaa vyote viwili katika sentensi chanya.
ovl.es.en.gn.must-mustnt.note: Mustn't huonyesha kukatazwa, jambo tofauti kabisa na don't have to (kutokuwa na wajibu). Yatofautishe.
ovl.es.en.gn.narrative-tenses.note: Mgawanyo huu kati ya matukio (wakati uliopita rahisi) na mandhari ya nyuma (uliopita endelevu) hufanana na mgawanyo uliopo katika lugha nyingine — silika hiyo huhamia vizuri Kiingerezani.
ovl.es.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Lugha nyingine huweka viwakilishi vya shamirisho kabla ya kitenzi; Kiingereza huviweka baada yake: "I'll call you. I see her. Ask him."
ovl.es.en.gn.passive-past.note: Hali tendwa ya wakati uliopita mara nyingi hulingana moja kwa moja na lugha nyingine: "was built in 1900."
ovl.es.en.gn.passive-present.note: Badala ya muundo wa "hujitendea" unaopatikana katika baadhi ya lugha, Kiingereza hutumia be pamoja na kitenzi cha wakati timilifu: "Spanish is spoken" huelezea kinachofanyika, si nani anayekifanya.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-be.note: Maumbo kadhaa tofauti ya "kuwa" wakati uliopita katika lugha nyingine hurahisishwa kuwa was/were tu Kiingereza — usitafute mgawanyo wa kina bado.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-cont.note: Muundo huu mara nyingi hulingana na lugha nyingine: was au were pamoja na kitenzi-ing, kama "I was eating."
ovl.es.en.gn.past-perfect.note: Muundo huu hulingana moja kwa moja na lugha nyingine: had pamoja na kitenzi cha wakati timilifu, kama "had eaten."
ovl.es.en.gn.past-reg.note: Kiishio -ed kina sauti tatu: /t/ (worked), /d/ (played), /ɪd/ (visited). Sema "visited" kwa silabi tatu, "worked" kwa moja.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.note: Tendo linalokatizwa huchukua was -ing, na tendo la haraka huchukua -ed: "I was cooking when he arrived."
ovl.es.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.note: Lugha nyingine mara nyingi hazitofautishi hili, lakini Kiingereza hufanya hivyo: "I've painted it" (matokeo) dhidi ya "I've been painting" (shughuli).
ovl.es.en.gn.phrasal-separable.note: Muundo huu hauna mfano dhahiri katika lugha nyingine, hivyo jifunze mpangilio wenyewe: ni "turn it on", si "turn on it", kiwakilishi kikiwa katikati.
ovl.es.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: Neno linaloweza kuwa umoja katika lugha nyingine ni wingi Kiingereza: "people are friendly", si "people is."
ovl.es.en.gn.poss-adj.note: Neno moja la umiliki linaloweza kutumika kwa kila mtu katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza: his, her, its, na their — kila moja hulingana na mmiliki, si kitu kinachomilikiwa.
ovl.es.en.gn.poss-s.note: Muundo wa 's huweka mmiliki kwanza na kitu kinachomilikiwa pili: "Ana's dog" — jambo lisilo na mfano wa moja kwa moja katika lugha nyingine.
ovl.es.en.gn.prep-place.note: Neno moja la mahali linaloweza kufanya kazi tatu katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza kuwa in, on, na at.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-cont-future.note: Wakati uliopo endelevu pamoja na neno la wakati hubeba maana ya mpango: "I'm meeting Ana at six."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-cont.note: Muundo huu hulingana na lugha nyingine nyingi: be + kitenzi-ing, kama "I am eating."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.note: Tofauti hii kati ya "amekwenda bado yupo huko" na "amekwenda na kurudi" inaonyeshwa Kiingereza na maneno tofauti: gone (bado yupo huko) na been (alikwenda na kurudi). "Has gone to Lima" inamaanisha bado yuko huko.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.note: Muundo wa "nimekuwa nikiishi kwa muda" unaopatikana katika lugha nyingine kwa njia tofauti, Kiingereza hutumia have been -ing: "I have been living here for two years."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.note: Hufanana na muundo wa uzoefu unaopatikana katika lugha nyingine, lakini Kiingereza haikubali wakati uliopo timilifu pamoja na wakati uliokamilika: "I have eaten at two" si sahihi — ukishataja wakati, tumia wakati uliopita rahisi.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.note: Hii ni kosa la kawaida kwa wanafunzi: mara tu wakati unapotajwa — hata "today at two" — Kiingereza hutaka wakati uliopita rahisi, si wakati uliopo timilifu.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.note: Neno moja la "tayari/bado" katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza kutegemea aina ya sentensi: already katika sentensi chanya, yet katika maswali na ukanushaji. "I have just eaten."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: Lugha nyingi huweka kiishio kwa kila nafsi, hivyo -s pekee ya Kiingereza huweza kusahaulika kwa urahisi. Ni kosa la kawaida la A1: "she work" inahitaji -s yake — "she works."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: Lugha nyingine huweka nafsi ndani ya kiishio cha kitenzi; Kiingereza huacha kitenzi bila kubadilika na hutegemea kiwakilishi: I speak, you speak.
ovl.es.en.gn.pron-subject.note: Lugha nyingine huacha kiwakilishi cha kiima ("Soy Ana"); Kiingereza huhitaji kitajwe: "I am Ana" — "am Ana" pekee husikika si sahihi kwa masikio ya Kiingereza.
ovl.es.en.gn.question-tags.note: Baadhi ya lugha hutumia neno moja lisilobadilika mwishoni mwa swali; Kiingereza hurudia kitenzi kisaidizi na kukigeuza. Hii ni mojawapo ya tabia ngumu zaidi za B1, hivyo inahitaji mazoezi ya kudumu.
ovl.es.en.gn.rel-object-omit.note: Lugha nyingine huhifadhi neno la kurejea; Kiingereza huliacha kwa uhuru linapokuwa shamirisho: "the film we watched" halihitaji "that."
ovl.es.en.gn.rel-where-whose.note: Whose bado inahitajika katika Kiingereza sanifu: "the writer whose book won."
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-commands.note: Ombi linaloelezwa kwa hali ya kutegemeana katika lugha nyingine hubadilika kuwa tell au ask pamoja na to-infinitive Kiingereza: "she told me to wait."
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-questions.note: Kudumisha mpangilio wa swali ni kosa la kawaida: sahihi ni "she asked where I lived", si "asked where did I live."
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-statements.note: Kurudisha wakati nyuma hufanya kazi kama ilivyo katika lugha nyingine; mtego wa kweli ni mpangilio wa maneno, ambao hubaki tambarare kama kauli katika Kiingereza.
ovl.es.en.gn.say-vs-tell.note: Neno moja la "kusema" katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza: tell inahitaji mtu (tell me), say haihitaji. Pia unasema "explain to me", si "explain me."
ovl.es.en.gn.should-advice.note: Should hufuatwa na kitenzi bila "to": "you should rest."
ovl.es.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: Kitenzi kimoja katika lugha nyingine hugawanyika Kiingereza: "I eat" ni tabia na "I am eating" ni sasa hivi. Chagua kwa msaada wa maneno ya wakati.
ovl.es.en.gn.so-because-although.note: Angalia kwamba because si sawa na "because of", na Kiingereza haliweki "although…but" pamoja — chagua kimoja tu.
ovl.es.en.gn.some-any.note: Lugha nyingine mara nyingi haziitaji neno lolote hapa; Kiingereza hupenda "some" katika sentensi chanya na "any" katika maswali na ukanushaji: "Do you have any money?"
ovl.es.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.note: Kiingereza huongeza neno ambalo lugha nyingine huliacha — "ever": "the best I have ever seen."
ovl.es.en.gn.sv-order.note: Lugha nyingine huruhusu maneno kuhamahama kwa uhuru zaidi; Kiingereza hushikilia mpangilio wa Kiima–Kitenzi–Shamirisho. Weka mtendaji kwanza, hata kama inasikika kurudia.
ovl.es.en.gn.there-is-are.note: Neno moja lisilobadilika la "kuna" katika lugha nyingine hubadilika kulingana na idadi Kiingereza: there IS a cafe, there ARE two cafes.
ovl.es.en.gn.time-clauses.note: Ambapo lugha nyingine hutumia hali ya kutegemeana, Kiingereza hutumia tu wakati uliopo: "when I arrive." "When I will arrive" si sahihi.
ovl.es.en.gn.time-prep.note: Maneno machache ya lugha nyingine hugawanyika mara tatu katika vipashio vya wakati vya Kiingereza: at five, on Monday, in May. Jifunze hivi vitatu kama kundi moja.
ovl.es.en.gn.time-telling.note: Kiingereza hutumia "it's" ya umoja kwa saa yoyote, pamoja na o'clock kwa saa kamili: "It's three o'clock."
ovl.es.en.gn.too-enough.note: Enough huja BAADA ya kivumishi lakini KABLA ya nomino: "warm enough, enough time."
ovl.es.en.gn.too-to-so-that.note: Muundo huu hubeba matokeo ndani ya kivumishi: "too tired to drive" na "so tired that I slept."
ovl.es.en.gn.unless.note: Ambapo lugha nyingine hutumia hali ya kutegemeana baada ya "isipokuwa", Kiingereza hutumia tu wakati uliopo baada ya unless: "unless we leave."
ovl.es.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.note: Umbo moja la wakati uliopita katika lugha nyingine hufanya kazi zote mbili; Kiingereza hugawanya: tumia used to kwa hali za zamani, na would kwa matendo yaliyojirudia.
ovl.es.en.gn.used-to.note: Tabia ya zamani inayoelezwa kwa umbo maalum la wakati katika lugha nyingine huwa "used to" pamoja na kitenzi bila kubadilika Kiingereza: "I used to run" — used to run, si used to ran.
ovl.es.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.note: Ombi linaloelezwa kwa hali ya kutegemeana katika lugha nyingine hubadilika kuwa shamirisho pamoja na infinitive Kiingereza: "I want you to come."
ovl.es.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.note: Muundo unaofuata kitenzi hubeba maana: "stop smoking" (kuacha) dhidi ya "remember to do" (kukumbuka kufanya).
ovl.es.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: Neno dogo la mahali (from) huhamia mwishoni katika maswali ya kawaida ya Kiingereza: "Where are you from?"
ovl.es.en.gn.will-decide-offer.note: Ambapo lugha nyingine hutumia wakati uliopo kutoa ofa, Kiingereza hutumia will wakati wa kuamua papo hapo: "I'll help you."
ovl.es.en.gn.will-predict.note: Kiingereza hutumia umbo moja tu la will kwa kila nafsi kutabiri: will rain hufaa kila mtu, bila kubadilika.
ovl.es.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.note: Kiingereza hudai uchaguzi kati ya mpango ulio tayari (going to) na uamuzi wa papo hapo (will) — jambo ambalo lugha nyingine haliuliziki kwa uwazi kama huo.
ovl.es.en.gn.wish-past.note: Umbo la wakati uliopita baada ya wish ndilo linaloonyesha kuwa jambo si halisi: "I wish I had a garden."
ovl.es.en.gn.would-like-offers.note: "Would you like…?" ndiyo njia ya heshima ya kutoa ofa, laini zaidi kuliko kuuliza moja kwa moja: "Would you like a coffee?"
ovl.es.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like" ni njia ya heshima inayofaa katika mikahawa, maduka, na mahoteli.
